game.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3
game.blurb: First-person military shooter from Infinity Ward, Sledgehammer Games and others (RAWG lists Aspyr Media, Raven Software, Treyarch, Infinity Ward, Sledgehammer Games and Neversoft Entertainment), published by Activision Blizzard, released 2011-11-08. RAWG average playtime: 8 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters follow the 16 campaign missions named in the Steam achievements, plus Veteran, Intel and Special Ops.

chapters.title: Missions: Black Tuesday to Back on the Grid
chapters.summary: Starting the campaign, then Black Tuesday, Hunter Killer, Persona Non Grata, Turbulence and Back on the Grid, with their mission feats.

chapters.title: Missions: Mind the Gap to Iron Lady
chapters.summary: Mind the Gap, Goalpost, Return to Sender, Bag and Drag and Iron Lady, with their mission feats. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Missions: Eye of the Storm to Dust to Dust
chapters.summary: Eye of the Storm, Blood Brothers, Stronghold, Scorched Earth, Down the Rabbit Hole and Dust to Dust, and finishing the campaign. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Veteran Runs and Intel
chapters.summary: The campaign on Hardened or Veteran, the six Veteran mission groups, and collecting 22 and 46 Intel Items.

chapters.title: Special Ops Mission Mode
chapters.summary: Stars in Mission Mode, matching your partner, no one downed, and knifing a Juggernaut.

chapters.title: Special Ops Survival
chapters.summary: Surviving waves, reaching Waves 10 and 15 in each mission, the armories and $50,000.

chapters.title: Hidden Special Ops Missions
chapters.summary: 26 achievements hidden on Steam; RAWG ties most of them to the Special Ops missions Negotiator, Black Ice, Kill Switch, Iron Clad, Arctic Recon, Special Delivery, Light 'Em Up and Vertigo.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Call_of_Duty:_Modern_Warfare_3
Fandom (callofduty.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://callofduty.fandom.com/wiki/Call_of_Duty:_Modern_Warfare_3
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 11276); RAWG keeps the 2023 "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III" separately. The Steam store list has app 42680 ("Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 3 (2011)"); its schema is named "ValveTestApp42680" (a placeholder name) and returned 76 achievements, 27 of them hidden. The mission order comes from the Veteran group achievements, which list all 16 missions in six groups and agree with the unlock rates; "Dust to Dust" appears only in a Veteran group and has no clear achievement of its own. Splitting the missions 5, 5 and 6 is our own choice. 26 hidden achievements (1.5% to 3.6%) sit in the hidden Special Ops chapter: RAWG's descriptions tie 25 of them to the eight Special Ops missions named in the chapter summary, and "EMPressive…" (blank on RAWG too) was put there by its similar unlock rate, a guess. The other hidden one, "Flight Attendant" (17.7%, not in RAWG's list), sits with the first five missions because its schema position is among the Persona Non Grata and Back on the Grid feats, a guess. "Strike!" and "Jack the Ripper" (Single Player or Special Ops) sit in the first mission chapter as a placeholder. StrategyWiki has "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3" at completion stage 0: only Achievements and trophies (about 9,100 characters) and Table of Contents are written; Gameplay, Controls, Walkthrough and Challenges are linked but not written. callofduty.fandom.com answers the API under "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3" with at least 500 linked articles (the API's page limit was reached); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
